info.title: RouteMesh API
info.description: HTTP API for routing JSON-RPC requests across providers, managing API keys, and viewing usage.

servers.description: API server — health, chains, API keys, usage, and public submissions

tags.name: RPC
tags.description: Forward JSON-RPC requests to the router.

tags.name: Submissions
tags.description: Public chain and node listing requests (rate-limited per IP).

tags.name: API Keys
tags.description: Manage your API keys for self-service access.

tags.name: Usage
tags.description: View your usage and billing data.

tags.name: Pricing
tags.description: Current RPC route and websocket notification prices (public, rate-limited).

tags.name: Provider
tags.description: Provider-scoped management endpoints for managing node plans, methods, and nodes. Authenticated with a management token whose customer is linked to a provider.

get.description: Public health endpoint used by load balancers and uptime checks.

200.description: Service is healthy and serving requests

example.message: The service is ready to serve requests

get.description: Returns the EVM chains supported over HTTP RPC, sorted by chain ID. Public endpoint, no authentication required. Returns an empty array when no chains are supported.
Returns the EVM chains supported over WebSocket, sorted by chain ID. Public endpoint, no authentication required. Returns an empty array when no chains are supported.

post.description: Send a single JSON-RPC request or a JSON-RPC batch (array). Replace {apiKey} with your actual API key.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain ID (e.g. 1 for Ethereum, 137 for Polygon, 8453 for Base).

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: Your RouteMesh API key (from the dashboard).

400.description: Bad request (e.g. invalid JSON or invalid JSON-RPC payload)

422.description: Unprocessable entity (e.g. chain not supported or method not supported)

424.description: Failed dependency (all upstream providers failed with non-2xx responses)

429.description: Too many requests (all upstream providers rate limited / on cooldown)

504.description: Gateway timeout (router timed out waiting for upstream providers)

post.description: Send a single JSON-RPC request or a JSON-RPC batch (array) to the public, anonymous free tier. No API key required. Rate-limited per IP. For higher volume, use an API key at /rpc/{chainId}/{apiKey}.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain ID (e.g. 1 for Ethereum, 137 for Polygon, 8453 for Base).

400.description: Bad request (e.g. invalid JSON or invalid JSON-RPC payload)

429.description: Too many requests (public per-IP rate limit exceeded)

503.description: Service temporarily unavailable (public free-tier capacity exhausted or unrelated)

get.description: Returns the authenticated customer's API keys. Excludes the secret key value; use X-Hint for identification.

post.description: Creates a new API key for the authenticated customer. The secret key value is returned once — store it securely.

400.description: Bad request (invalid domains, routing strategy, or missing fields)

get.description: Returns customer-scoped usage aggregates. Supports filtering by time range, chain, API key, grouping, and granularity. By default returns summary and balance.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start time (RFC3339). Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End time (RFC3339). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of sections to include. Options: summary, balance, by_chain, by_api_key, by_api_key_chain, top_methods, time_series, by_scenario. Default: summary,balance.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Group usage by a dimension. Options: chain, api_key, api_key,chain, method, day.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time bucket size. Options: day, hour. Default: day.

parameters.name: chain_id
parameters.description: Filter by chain ID (e.g. 1, 137, 8453).

parameters.name: api_key_id
parameters.description: Filter by API key numeric ID (found in list response).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows returned (default and max depend on config).

400.description: Bad request (invalid time range, include value, group_by, or granularity)

put.description: Partially updates one of the authenticated customer's API keys by numeric ID. Omitted fields leave the stored value unchanged. Use the id from GET /api-keys.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Numeric API key ID (from GET /api-keys). Not the secret rm_ key string.

400.description: Bad request (invalid domains or non-numeric id)

post.description: Public endpoint to request listing a new chain. Rate-limited to 5 submissions per IP per day. Optional X-Api-Key with an admin or agent management token skips the per-IP limit. Submitted RPC URLs are screened; at least one must qualify.

409.description: Chain already exists or pending request exists for this chain ID

post.description: Public endpoint to request listing a new RPC node. Rate-limited to 3 submissions per IP per day. Optional X-Api-Key with an admin or agent management token skips the per-IP limit. The node URL must be HTTPS and pass mandatory EVM screening.

409.description: Node URL already exists or pending request exists

get.description: Public endpoint returning current RPC route prices for each vm, chain ID, method, and routing strategy combination. No authentication required. Rate-limited per IP (default 30 requests per 60 seconds). Empty results return an empty JSON array.

parameters.name: vm
parameters.description: Filter by virtual machine type (e.g. evm).

parameters.name: chain_id
parameters.description: Filter by chain ID (e.g. 1, 137, 8453).

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Filter by JSON-RPC method (e.g. eth_blockNumber).

parameters.name: routing_strategy
parameters.description: Filter by routing strategy.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (per-IP limit; default 30 requests per 60 seconds)

get.description: Public endpoint returning current websocket notification prices per chain ID and subscription type. No authentication required. Rate-limited per IP (default 30 requests per 60 seconds). Empty results return an empty JSON array.

parameters.name: chain_id
parameters.description: Filter by chain ID (e.g. 1, 137, 8453).

parameters.name: subscription_type
parameters.description: Filter by websocket subscription type (e.g. newHeads).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (per-IP limit; default 30 requests per 60 seconds)

get.description: Returns the authenticated provider's pricing plans, or an empty array when the provider has none. Plan creation and pricing edits remain admin-managed.

200.description: List of plans or empty array

403.description: Provider not resolved - token's customer is not linked to a provider

get.description: Returns the RPC method rows configured for one of the authenticated provider's plans. Returns an empty array when the plan has no methods. Plans not owned by the caller's provider are reported as 404.

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: Numeric plan ID.

200.description: List of method rows or empty array

404.description: Plan not found (or not owned by the caller's provider)

post.description: Appends RPC method rows (1-500) to one of the authenticated provider's plans. The plan must be owned by the caller's provider (otherwise 404).

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: Numeric plan ID.

201.description: Plan methods inserted. Returns a plain-text success message.

400.description: Invalid plan id, request body, or validation failure

404.description: Plan not found (or not owned by the caller's provider)

get.description: Returns the synchronization status of one of the authenticated provider's nodes. Nodes not owned by the caller's provider are reported as 404.

parameters.name: nodeId
parameters.description: Numeric node ID.

404.description: Node not found (or not owned by the caller's provider)

put.summary: Create or update an HTTP node
put.description: Creates or updates an HTTP RPC node for one of the authenticated provider's plans. The URL must be a public http(s) endpoint (loopback, private, and link-local hosts are rejected). The node is screened before persistence; the request fails with 400 when a mandatory screening test does not pass. Returns the upserted node set to a healthy status.

400.description: Invalid request body, non-public URL, or failed mandatory screening

404.description: Plan or node not found (or not owned by the caller's provider)

409.description: Node URL already exists in a different plan

put.summary: Create or update a WebSocket node
put.description: Creates or updates a WebSocket RPC node for one of the authenticated provider's plans. The URL must be a public wss:// endpoint (loopback, private, and link-local hosts are rejected) that accepts eth_subscribe("newHeads"); the server dials the node to verify before persisting. Returns the upserted node set to a healthy status.

400.description: Invalid request body, non-public URL, or failed newHeads acceptance screening

404.description: Plan not found (or not owned by the caller's provider)

409.description: URL already registered to another plan

post.summary: Enable, disable, or delete a node
post.description: Sets the status of one of the authenticated provider's nodes to enable, disable, or delete (hide). Allowed statuses: healthy, disabled by provider, provider-deleted.

400.description: Invalid request body, node id, or status

404.description: Node not found (or not owned by the caller's provider)

MgmtKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key
MgmtKeyAuth.description: Management token from the RouteMesh dashboard (Settings → Management Tokens). Required for customer API endpoints (/api-keys, /usage). Tokens are prefixed rmtm_ and scoped to your account. Authenticate by passing the token in the X-Api-Key header. Separate from RPC service keys (rm_), which authenticate dApp traffic to the routing layer.

routing_strategy.description: Routing strategy the price applies to.

JsonRpcError.description: JSON-RPC error object. See [RPC Error Codes](/rpc-error-codes) for full code → meaning and when each occurs.

code.description: Router error codes: -32700 (parse error), -32600 (invalid request), -32601 (insufficient credits), -32602 (invalid params), -32603 (internal error), -32000 (server error), -32001 (chain not supported), -32002 (method not supported), -32003 (all nodes on cooldown), -32005 (eth_getLogs query limit exceeded), -32007 (no block-param capable nodes), -32008 (no providers available), -32009 (all nodes failed), -32011 (no opcode-capable nodes), -32012 (insufficient historical state depth), -32013 (no single provider satisfies all constraints), -32029 (public per-IP rate limit exceeded), -32030 (public free-tier capacity exhausted). See the RPC error codes guide for details.

message.description: Human-readable error message. eth_getLogs limit errors may include a block-range hint suffix: "; try a block range of at most N blocks".

allowed_domains.description: List of allowed origins/domains. Requests from other domains are rejected with 403.

routing_strategy.description: economy — most competitive prices; performance — fastest routes.

allowed_domains.description: Replace allowed domains list. Omit to keep current value.

name.description: Update friendly name. Omit to keep current value.

active.description: Activate or deactivate the key. Omit to keep current value.

api_key.description: The secret API key. Save this — it is returned only once.

credits_consumed.description: Total credits spent in the period.

groups.description: Grouped results when group_by is specified.

rpc_urls.description: HTTPS RPC URLs to screen (max 5). At least one must pass screening.

node_target_type.description: Node target type the method routes to.

chain_id.description: Chain this cost applies to; null/omitted for all chains.

plan_id.description: Plan ID the node belongs to (must be owned by the provider).

url.description: Public http(s) endpoint URL of the node.

plan_id.description: Plan ID the WebSocket node belongs to (must be owned by the provider).

chain_id.description: Chain ID the node serves, e.g. 137.

url.description: Public wss:// endpoint URL; must accept eth_subscribe("newHeads").

status.description: healthy (enable), disabled by provider (disable), or provider-deleted (delete).

XBatchId.description: Correlation ID for this HTTP request. Save it and share with RouteMesh support to help trace requests across logs and analytics.
